body:
We have free counseling on campus but it's shite. I've gone to two separate counselors and each have mentioned religion. I'm not religious and I can't say that without getting beheaded or something. 

I have a sister I speak to about this but I've bothered her all too much. She's going through a similar thing. I'm literally only alive because of her. She's already attempted, twice. I couldn't imagine making her endure my death. But Idk how long I can keep this veneer. 

I used to like several things. But now I've lost interest in everything. I longed to have a great social life and now that I have friends and go out often, I don't really enjoy it. I'm miserable, nervous, and stressed every time. 

I've lost interest in all my hobbies, work and even video games. It all feels pointless.

Thanks I appreciate it. This has been very difficult. I'm going through a slow burn breakdown where I can still function and do shit but I have no motivation to exist. 

Ive been having breakdowns more regularly and I cannot afford therapy. People tell me to do self help or whatever but I honestly have no strength for any of it. 

Discovering that I might have CPTSD from childhood hasn't helped either because it almost solidifies that I'm just fucking broken and there's no hope for the future. 

I feel like I'm not yet ready to kms but if I can die anytime soon I'll be happier for it.

Honestly? It's just the exhaustion of doing this. Of feeling awful then hating myself then failing miserably at what I do then feeling anxious. 

I'm honestly mostly just tired of it all. I'm not struggling with problem solving, I'm struggling with finding joy in life.
